# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 100 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 100 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_100_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Power of Names

**1** "Now explain the virgins to me, Lord," I said. "Don't you know who they are?" he asked. **2** "No, Lord," I said. "The twelve virgins are spirits," he replied. **3** "But why don't they all share the same name? Let me explain. **4** The four corner virgins are the strongest among them — they lead all the others. **5** Anyone who takes on their names will enter God's kingdom. **6** The weaker ones standing between them also have their names — **7** and anyone who takes on the names of both the corner virgins and the ones between them will likewise enter God's kingdom." **8** "Do the virgins actually have power?" I asked. **9** "Yes, they have genuine power," he said. "All these holy spirits have power, and anyone who identifies with their names cannot help but live in accordance with those spirits. **10** Now, look at the women in the black garments and tell me who you think they are." **11** "There are also twelve of them," he said, "and they are sisters of the virgins — but opposites. Their names are: Unbelief, Excess, Disobedience, Deception, Grief, Wickedness, Lust, Bitterness, Dishonesty, and Hatred. **12** Any of God's servants who are characterized by these names will not enter the kingdom of God — they will be thrown out." **13** "And the stones that were rejected and wouldn't fit the tower?" **14** "These are the dry ones," he said — "people bearing the names of these wicked women. They can't fit because they've been roughened and scarred by those destructive spirits."

---

*PNEUMA renders the "bearing of names" as "identifying with" — capturing the idea that virtue-names are identities that shape behavior rather than mere labels.*
